# NaKmetiji.si

> Slovenia's premier farm tourism platform (agritourism marketplace).
> Connects travelers with authentic Slovenian farm stays, culinary experiences, wine tours, and rural getaways.
> All farms are verified, bookable, and reviewed by real guests.

## What is NaKmetiji.si?

NaKmetiji.si is Slovenia's leading agritourism platform (turistične kmetije). It allows travelers to:
- Browse and book farm stays across all 12 Slovenian regions
- Discover farm experiences: wine tasting, cooking classes, horse riding, hiking
- Read verified guest reviews and ratings
- Access the AI Oracle concierge for personalized farm recommendations

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://nakmetiji.si/): Browse featured farms and search by region/experience
- [All Farms](https://nakmetiji.si/kmetije): Full searchable directory of Slovenian tourist farms
- [Interactive Map](https://nakmetiji.si/zemljevid): Map view of all farms with filters
- [Green Passport](https://nakmetiji.si/green-passport): Loyalty stamp program for repeat visitors
- [Blog](https://nakmetiji.si/blog): Travel guides and farm tourism articles

## Regions (12 Slovenian regions, each with farm listings)

- [Gorenjska](https://nakmetiji.si/regije/gorenjska) — Alpine region, Triglav, Lake Bled
- [Primorska](https://nakmetiji.si/regije/primorska) — Mediterranean, Karst, Adriatic coast
- [Štajerska](https://nakmetiji.si/regije/stajerska) — Wine country, Maribor area
- [Dolenjska](https://nakmetiji.si/regije/dolenjska) — Krka river valley, orchards
- [Savinjska](https://nakmetiji.si/regije/savinjska) — Hops country, Logarska valley
- [Pomurska](https://nakmetiji.si/regije/pomurska) — Pannonian plains, Jeruzalem vineyards
- [Koroška](https://nakmetiji.si/regije/koroska) — Mountain region, Pohorje
- [Notranjska](https://nakmetiji.si/regije/notranjska) — Postojna cave, Lake Cerknica
- [Posavska](https://nakmetiji.si/regije/posavska) — Sava river, Bizeljsko wine caves
- [Zasavska](https://nakmetiji.si/regije/zasavska) — Zagorje valley
- [Jugovzhodna Slovenija](https://nakmetiji.si/regije/jugovzhodna_slovenija) — Kočevje, wildlife
- [Osrednjeslovenska](https://nakmetiji.si/regije/osrednjeslovenska) — Ljubljana surroundings

## AI Oracle

NaKmetiji.si features an AI travel concierge ("Orakel") that understands natural language queries in Slovenian, English, German, and Italian. It recommends farms based on:
- User mood/vibe (quiet, romantic, family, eco, luxury)
- Region preference
- Guest capacity
- Specific experiences (wine, food, animals, hiking)
- Proximity to landmarks

## Farm Experience Categories

Prenočišče (lodging) · Kulinarika (local cuisine) · Vino (wine tasting) · Konji (horse riding) · Živali (farm animals) · Pohodništvo (hiking) · Kolesarstvo (cycling) · Kuharski tečaj (cooking class) · Wellness · Ribolov (fishing) · Ekološka kmetija (organic farm)
